dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you look surprised. Is everything OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈlʊk sərˈpraɪzd. ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There's been a change of plan. I was going to go to Toronto in January, but they've postponed the exchange until September.
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz bɪn ə ˈtʃeɪndʒ əv ˈplæn. aɪ wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈɡoʊ tə təˈrɑːntoʊ ɪn ˈdʒænjuɛri, bʌt ðeɪv poʊstˈpoʊnd ði ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ənˈtɪl sɛpˈtɛmbər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They're fixing their dormitory. It was very unexpected.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈfɪksɪŋ ðɛr ˈdɔːrmətɔːri. ɪt wʌz ˈvɛri ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I know how you feel. I was going to visit my family in Canada in 2020, but then the pandemic started.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ ˈhaʊ juː ˈfiːl. aɪ wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈfæməli ɪn ˈkænədə ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti, bʌt ˈðɛn ðə pænˈdɛmɪk ˈstɑːrtɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, right. Were all the flights canceled?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈraɪt. wɜːr ˈɔːl ðə ˈflaɪts ˈkænsəld?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. The situation changed every week, so I didn't see them for two years.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən ˈtʃeɪndʒd ˈɛvri ˈwiːk, soʊ aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈsiː ðɛm fər ˈtuː ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible. Well, at least I'll have more time to save money now.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl. ˈwɛl, ət ˈliːst aɪl ˈhæv ˈmɔːr ˈtaɪm tə ˈseɪv ˈmʌni ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a good way to think. Is there any good news?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡʊd ˈweɪ tə ˈθɪŋk. ɪz ðɛr ˈɛni ˈɡʊd ˈnuːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Emma got a job in Bangkok. She was going to start in December, but they want her to start next month!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈɛmə ˈɡɑːt ə ˈdʒɑːb ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk. ʃiː wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstɑːrt ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər, bʌt ðeɪ ˈwɑːnt hɜːr tə ˈstɑːrt ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So she's coming back soon? That's great news!
dialogue.reading: soʊ ʃiːz ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈbæk ˈsuːn? ðæts ˈɡreɪt ˈnuːz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! We were going to meet in Toronto, but now we'll meet in Bangkok first!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! wiː wɜːr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈmiːt ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ, bʌt ˈnaʊ wiːl ˈmiːt ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk ˈfɜːrst!
